Automation._comment: Target environments. Only non-secret values belong here. Keys are SECRETS: set them with user-secrets or env vars, e.g. dotnet user-secrets set "Automation:Environments:production:IngestKey" "..." (env var form: Automation__Environments__production__IngestKey). IngestKey = the main app's N8n:IngestApiKey, PlatformAdminKey = its PlatformAdmin:ApiKey, MetaWebhookVerifyToken = its Meta:WebhookVerifyToken (optional).
